title: adjoint (infinity,1)-functor
why_consulted: vol1 ch12 全章讨论 (∞,2)-范畴中 1-态射的左/右伴随；定理 1.2.4 的万有可伴随函子把空间层面的伴随同构升级为 (∞,2)-范畴等价，需核 nLab 对 ∞-伴随的表述
definition_zh: (∞,1)-函子的伴随是普通伴随函子在 (∞,1)-范畴中的推广，有多种等价定义：可以用单位与余单位 2-态射以及同伦意义下的三角形恒等式定义，也可以用映射空间的自然同伦等价 Maps_D(L(c),d) ≃ Maps_C(c,R(d)) 定义。在 (∞,2)-范畴中，一个 1-态射 α 有左伴随当且仅当各映射空间函子 (α∘-) 有左伴随并满足 Beck–Chevalley 条件（引理 4.2.3），这就是本书逐对象判定伴随的方式。
key_points: 等价刻画之一：单位 id→R∘L 与余单位 L∘R→id 加上同伦三角形恒等式
等价刻画之二：映射空间 Maps(L(c),d) ≃ Maps(c,R(d)) 的自然同伦等价，便于逐对象验证
在 (∞,2)-范畴中，1-态射的伴随可逐对象检验；整体化为参数族后还要 Beck–Chevalley 条件保证相容性（引理 4.2.3）
本书定理 1.2.4 把「每个对象处有伴随」升级为 (∞,2)-范畴的等价，其证明通过 Yoneda 嵌入归约到 T=1-Cat 的情形
idea_original: The notion of adjunction between two (∞,1)-functors generalizes the notion of adjoint functors from category theory to (∞,1)-category theory. There are many equivalent definitions of the ordinary notion of adjoint functor. Some of them have more evident generalizations to some parts of higher category theory than others. One definition of ordinary adjoint functors says that a pair of functors C→R←LDC \stackrel{\overset{L}{\leftarrow}}{\underset{R}{\to}} D is an adjunction if there is a natural isomorphism Hom C(L(−),−)≃Hom D(−,R(−)). Hom_C(L(-),-) \simeq Hom_D(-,R(-)) \,. The analog of this definition makes sense very generally in (∞,1)-category theory, where Hom C(−,−):C op×C→∞GrpdHom_C(-,-) : C^{op} \times C \to \infty Grpd is the (∞,1)(\infty,1)-categorical hom-object. One other characterization of adjoint functors in terms of their cographs/heteromorphisms: the Cartesian fibrations to which the functor is associated. At cograph of a functor it is discussed how two functors L:C→DL : C \to D and R:D→CR : D \to C are adjoint precisely if the cograph of LL coincides with the cograph of RR up to the obvious reversal of arrows (L⊣R)⇔(cograph(L)≃cograph(R op) op). (L \dashv R) \Leftri
references: Emily Riehl, §18.6 in: Categorical Homotopy Theory, Cambridge University Press (2014) [doi:10.1017/CBO9781107261457]
